text:
sara_m: Pushed a small docs PR that adds a short how-to for creating a public Grafana snapshot to illustrate quota tier changes in the usage dashboard. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2622

leo_b: Nice. Can you include a tiny SDK snippet showing how to read the quota headers? Many folks miss the case-insensitive header names.

sara_m: added this JS example: 

```js
const remaining = res.headers.get('x-ratelimit-remaining')
const reset = res.headers.get('x-ratelimit-reset')
if (Number(remaining) === 0) await backoff() // example only
```

anita_p: tiny note: make header names lowercase in the snippet and call out Dedicated uses X-Redwood-Dedicated-Rate-*. Added a 1-line aside.

sara_m: updated. also swapped the example to SDKv5 request style per docs conventions.

infra-bot: lint alert: markdown code block language should be "javascript".

sara_m: fixed. thanks infra-bot.

leo_b: For the snapshot guidance, please recommend including a short annotation on the snapshot to explain which timeframe corresponds to the tier switch. Otherwise reviewers get confused.

sara_m: added a recommended caption and an example caption: "Free->Pro cutover at 2026-02-12T14:03Z — spike is backlog draining."

gabe_l: one more thought: include a note about grace periods and that billing migrations may not be instantaneous. folks assume the dashboard flips immediately.

sara_m: added a 2-line FAQ entry and linked to the billing migration playbook. merging after CI. :shipit:
